title: Rearrange
text: Moving the constant term to the right-hand side, we have \n $$\frac{x-3}{x-3}=2$$.

title: Interpret equation
text: If $$x=3$$, the left-hand side of $$\frac{x-3}{x-3}=2$$ is undefined. \n If $$x\neq$$ $$3, $$ then we can cancel the common factor and we get $$\frac{x-3}{x-3}=1=2$$, which does not make sense. Therefore, there is no solution.
